title: Four Verbs of the Mind
label: ch:fa-mind-verbs
canDo: I can say think, understand, read and write in Persian, give the present stem of each, and tell which of the three ways a Persian verb is built each one uses.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on neveshtan, nevis-, then runs its four verbs back to back — fekr kardan with kon-, fahmidan with fahm-, khândan with khân-, neveshtan with nevis- — and names which is a compound, which hands its stem over free, and which two had to be told. The five pairs from Chapter 6 run after them, so all nine are produced from memory in one sitting.
